text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Early February. Sweet gifts from fans were arriving at the academy one after another."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you get some this year too?
Chocolates from fans! I got way more
than last year~! It's enough to make me cry, seriously.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I got some too!
There're tons of letters!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It warms my heart so much,
having this many people cheering for me...♪
Ugaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm, what the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Teacherrr, check again, please-nodaaa!!
There's gotta be moreee!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Agh, that's all the ones delivered to the dorm.
I told you over and over they don't get delivered to the school...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, we got way more last year...
Maybe it got delivered here by mistake...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai, what's wrong?
Why are you making such a fuss...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh! It's not like I'm making a fuss...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko! How many chocolates
did you get from your fans, nanoda?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Chocolates?
Around this much...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nwa... ngh! T-That much...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuuuuu~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Humph! Windy-chan is busy with trainiiiiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: !?!? What is this...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Chocolate...? Ah, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Teacher! Where's the chocolate for Windy-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... perhaps because of the biting incident,
it seems the numbers have dropped drastically this year...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —*pant*, *pant*, *pant*... *whew*...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Dammit...
Just you wait and see...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Windy-senpaaaai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If it's training, want to do it together?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, why would I ever with someone like you?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? Because I wanna
train on the dirt track too, of course!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Next time, for Senior's sake too,
I'll aim for a Dirt GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bye-byee! ...is what I say!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hold on!! Hear me out!
Toh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I told you not to follow me...! Gah...!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa.
Were you always this fast...?!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, I'm getting stronger too, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even on dirt, if I put in a bit more running, I can do this!
I won't lose in the next February Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Wait a second!
The "February Stakes"...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"You're running too?!
Nobody told me about this!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I tried to talk to you earlier, but you wouldn't listen.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I have something I must do as a hero
at the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gotta blow away the Phantom Letterder!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Letter-der"??? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's about the label that was stuck on Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know what Windy-senpai is really like.
I know she takes her training seriously.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And yet, the world doesn't know that.
They misunderstand Senpai, thinking she's just some feral horse girl who bites.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It's frustrating, isn't it?
We can't just let things stay like this!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So let's show everyone.
A full-power clash between me and you, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna blow everyone's minds with an awesome battle.
That's right, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "I want to help Senpai! Answering the call for help, I'm running in the February Stakes!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Biko... You...
So you went all the way to the dirt track just for Windy-chan's sake...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, you sure are a curious one! But... you're right that everyone's got the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So Windy-chan should get some chocolate too!
Give me some of that chocolate you got, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not giving you that, okay?!
A fan gave it to me. But!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's train together for the main event!
We won't be able to beat Retterder unless we run an incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, so be it.
Then defeat it with a combined biting attack!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
N-No biting, but let's work together
and power up! Alright, here we go--!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Toyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on Valentine's Day,
Biko Pegasus came over holding a lovely box.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai and I made it together
between our training sessions!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, all things considered,
it's actually got a lot of great qualities!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!!
High-speed mixingggg!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wapu! That splashed just now!
Be much gentler, nanoda~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: If it's for Biko's Trainer who always helps Windy-chan out, I want to make it properly.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...And so they lent me a hand.
That's why it's super delicious!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now, eat this chocolate
while praying for world peace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus waits with a big grin for a reaction.
However...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Spicy!?
Ah, could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Is that Windy-senpai?!
Come to think of it, while making it...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I can't hold back anymore, I can't~.
Just a little bit... Just, a tiny bit...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Damn it! Phantom Windy, you fiend!
How dare you use grated wasabi on meee--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few minutes later... Biko Pegasus and
Shinko Windy could be seen chasing
each other outside the window...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chocolate was delicious.
Rich in milk, it had a flavor
that felt truly like Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! You're welcome!
But that's not the only present I got for ya!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Windy-senpai told me about a great spot!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Pretty, isn't it? It's amazing
that so many are in bloom this season!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this is my thanks for always taking such good care of me.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Carrotman said that looking at flowers makes your heart feel gentle!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a leisurely walk today.
We'll relax and do our best training together again later...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I spent a peaceful and heartwarming
time with Biko Pegasus...
